purpose: the placement test of a new harness, as the authorization requires before it joins: a new harness joins only after its first host run is BIT_IDENTICAL to its laptop run of the same population (recorded under results/L3_HOST/) and a dated addendum names it (the v1 declaration's new_harnesses rule)

harness.what: E1 read budget: the TYPED v1 walk (_l3d_typed, imported and sha-pinned) with a readable set that starts at the contacted nodes and grows by S whole shards or R node rows chosen by frontier mass; it recomputes every TYPED v1 arm and asserts S0 == PUSH and SINF == the unmasked walk per gated row, and compares its arrays with the TYPED v1 record

test.laptop: PYTHONHASHSEED=0 python -u scratchpad/_l3d_budget.py RUN metaqa v1 -> results/L3_DEV/l3budget_metaqa__v1.{json,npz}
test.host: rx run -n l3h-budget-h1 --cpus 2 --mem 3 --var OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=12 -- python -u scratchpad/_l3h_run.py scratchpad/_l3d_budget.py RUN metaqa h1 -> results/L3_DEV/l3budget_metaqa__h1.{json,npz}
test.gate: BIT_IDENTICAL; then a dated addendum names the harness; until then its host output is a test artifact only

why_the_typed_records: the harness asserts the TYPED v1 record's sha and compares its arrays member by member with it (laptop records of the same population, 2.6 MB; the host's own TYPED run h1 is byte-identical in its npz)
unchanged: the bundle, the runner, the BLAS setting of addendum 2, the authorization's pins and every 'never' of the declaration
